Additional risks: widening is_service_account semantics, @cache'd allowlist, verbatim OpenAPI baseline.

~11-15 modified or deleted (authentication.py, user_type_validator.py, config.py, main.py, servicenow router/service/access removal, guarded_app.py, OpenAPI baseline, mock_config in 5 test files, auth tests) and 6+ new (router package __init__ + projects module, provisioning models, access module, registry loader, registry YAML, new tests) across security, routers, models, configs, config/ and tests.
